tags.name: Japanese Ship Wreck
tags.qa_note: RESOLVED 2026-08-18 (was unresolved). This node's coordinates sit within ~250m of the PADI-listed 'Lighthouse Wreck' / 'Japanese Wreck Marine Sanctuary' (11.34233, 124.10993), and four independent sources describe a shallow (3-7m average, broken in two pieces) WWII-era Japanese vessel at that location. The prior depth of 33m did not match any known wreck at this location and has been corrected to 3-7m. No other candidate wreck (Tapilon Wreck ~29m off mainland Tapilon town, or MV Dona Marilyn ~33m off Biliran) sits at these coordinates. Sources disagree on vessel type and sinking narrative: most describe a landing craft carrying cement for gun emplacements, bombed short of the beach; one source describes it instead as a warship that was detected and bombed while sheltering nearby. No ship name, build date, length, or tonnage could be verified from any source and none is claimed.
